The '''Jovan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
With three fertile [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]], including [[Jovan III]], the Jovan system was the premier food source of the Gordian Reach. Those [[Planet/Legends|planets]] were crisscrossed by [[Harvester droid/Legends|robo-harvesters]] and dotted with agricultural research labs.<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] converted the [[Jovan Station]] as the headquarters of the [[Yavin blockade]]. This seriously affected the commerce of the entire [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA" />
